question: Give the product a clear first impression.

patterns.label: Feature-led composition
patterns.summary: Pair the proposition with a compact product view.
patterns.best_when: Visitors need to understand capability quickly
patterns.tradeoff: Two columns share the first viewport

patterns.label: Story-led composition
patterns.summary: Lead with a centered proposition and wide product view.
patterns.best_when: A single message should lead the narrative
patterns.tradeoff: Details move farther down the page

constraint: Use identical content and viewport. Confirm both alternatives satisfy the business requirements before offering.
criteria: Let the workspace tell part of the story
